import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd

etfs = ['VGT', 'MGK', 'VONG']
start_date = '2013-01-01'
end_date = '2023-12-31'

rows = []

# Use auto_adjust=False and read 'Adj Close' to explicitly get adjusted closes
for t in etfs:
    df = yf.download(t, start=start_date, end=end_date, auto_adjust=False)
    first_day = df.index.min()
    last_day = df.index.max()
    start_px = float(df.loc[first_day, 'Adj Close'])
    end_px = float(df.loc[last_day, 'Adj Close'])
    rows.append({
        'ETF': t,
        'Start Date': str(first_day.date()),
        'Start Price (Adj Close)': round(start_px, 2),
        'End Date': str(last_day.date()),
        'End Price (Adj Close)': round(end_px, 2)
    })

out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(out)
```

# filename: robust_medians.py
import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd

etfs = ['VGT', 'MGK', 'VONG']
start_date = '2013-01-01'
end_date = '2023-12-31'

results = []

for t in etfs:
    df = yf.download(t, start=start_date, end=end_date, auto_adjust=True)
    # Resample to monthly closes
    monthly = df['Close'].resample('M').last().to_frame('Close')
    # Split by year
    m2013 = monthly[(monthly.index.year == 2013)].copy()
    m2023 = monthly[(monthly.index.year == 2023)].copy()

    if t == 'VGT':
        # Drop top 3 months in 2023 by Close before median
        m2023_sorted = m2023.sort_values(by='Close', ascending=False)
        m2023_trimmed = m2023_sorted.iloc[3:].copy()
        med_2013 = float(m2013['Close'].median())
        med_2023 = float(m2023_trimmed['Close'].median())
    else:
        med_2013 = float(m2013['Close'].median())
        med_2023 = float(m2023['Close'].median())

    results.append({
        'ETF': t,
        'Median Close 2013': round(med_2013, 2),
        'Median Close 2023 (trim if VGT)': round(med_2023, 2)
    })

out = pd.DataFrame(results)
print(out)
```
